consumer_rules: SPK Derivatives never recomputes or upgrades Policy Lab evidence assurance.
A blocked Policy Lab evaluation never becomes a downstream exposure.
Multiple admitted policy evaluations require explicit policy selection.
The admitted claim unit is preserved exactly at the Policy Lab boundary.
A semantic claim unit is never assumed equivalent to physical energy or a market settlement unit.
Any claim-unit to market-quantity mapping must be represented as a separate SPK policy-market binding with its own identity and declared basis.
drift_policy: A new Policy Lab schema/profile/blob is incompatible until reviewed and this manifest is updated deliberately.
